Why all the commented out code?

I kept the one in packet-nas_5gs.c because if the missing data is dissected if could be easy to forget to add it back in.  I don't feel strongly - would you rather it deleted?

In packet-oran.c, there are much deeper checks I could between the C and U planes, that field was the start of that, but its not used yet.

In packet-tcpcl.c, the check was redundant (if not immediately obvious), so I left it in a comment.  Happy to remove it..

Commented out code is just noise, IMHO. If there's a place in the code that forms a starting point for future development, then a comment line or block hinting to the to be developed feature is best. The rest should be cleaned out. It's not that it's lost anyway, it's in the commit history.
